description: A Union-aligned planet serving as a Galactic Union military command center and high-technology industrial hub. Orbitfall Station (loc_orbitfall_station) is a secure Union facility in orbit above it. Kaelor Prime was the setting of a scenario in which the planet suffered an unauthorized memory leak from a rogue Sentinel unit, with a Velar Loyalist operative intercepting the classified communications for release to Outer Colony warlords.
